notes.title: Here, The Hellboy, Have a Trophy
notes.content:
It’s everyone’s favorite time of year: Advent. Calendars with treats in them? Sign me up!

[h3]Also, it’s Steam Awards season.[/h3]

[b]We humbly ask you, the community, to throw Hellboy Web of Wyrd a vote for the Outstanding Visual Style award.[/b] You do not have to do this at all. But if you did, boy would that be neat. Just a super neat thing for you to do.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]1.0.5 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[*]Boss blessings now unlock when reaching a level rather than completing it, giving more build variety earlier.

[b]QoL:[/b]
[*]Upgrade menu text has been made more readable.
[*]Prompts now display for longer (unless dismissed) to give more reading time.

[b]General:[/b]
[*]Enemy's sometimes taking damage while blocking.
[*]Incorrectly positioned enemy pre-attack warning effects.
[*]Minor graphical glitches.
[*]Multiple locking room issues.
[*]Enemy animation issue causing them to sometimes slide when blocking.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]1.0.4 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Update default key bindings for mouse and keyboard.
[*] Making sure new keybindings save properly between game sessions.
[*] Changing lock-on camera sensitivity for mouse and keyboard players to decrease accidental target switching, now proportional to mouse sensitivity.
[*] Decreasing input buffer from 0.5 seconds to 0.3seconds to reduce lag.
[*] Enabling Steam Cloud Sync for save files.
[*] Fixing enemy spawn issue with walls.
[*] Adding an enable/disable toggle for Hellboy's stylized walk cycle animation.
[*] Other bugs relating to lock on and animation clean ups.
[*] Fixes to Knife charm's teleportation distance.
[*] Fixes for menu navigation with "Game Options.
[*] Certain enemy special attacks now break lock on as intended.
[*] Players can hold 2 big keys
[*] Additional safety checks in procedural generation.
[/list]

[b]Balance changes to increase the overall difficulty curve:[/b]
[list]
  [*] Heavy attack & Breakable Damage Increased for Act 2 and 3 enemies.
  [*] Cooldown decreased for Intermediate, Advance & Expert Big Bads to make them more active while in combat.
  [*] Behaviour Tree Update - Cooldown starts at the end of the attack state.
  [*] Cheap attack have been made quicker.
  [*] Bat Swarm and Toxic Attack does more Damage.
  [*] Cheap Attacks have been rolled into Big Bad attack combos.
  [*] New Combo Attack variants have been added to some Big Bads.
  [*] Health, Toughness and Stun adjusted for some Big Bads (Spike Boar, Fox, Swarming Bat, Albino Bat, Flying Bat and Crawler)
[/list]

notes.title: THANK YOU!!!!
notes.content:
[h2]THANK YOU!!!![/h2]

We are truly overwhelmed and thrilled with your response to Hellboy Web of Wyrd. We’re all huge fans of Dark Horse and the comics, and this is a real labor of love to bring this IP to you all as a game.

Thank you for all the support, feedback, trailer comments and - most importantly - the trust you’ve shown us as a team. We know you’ve got a lot of questions and we’re looking forward to revealing more as we get closer to the launch. In the meantime, here’s our one week+ announcement brag thanks to you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315086/510614fb6c2845ec8f389d72df97c80dfc4280bf.png[/img]

Reading your comments, watching the social media channels rocket upward and seeing the press loving this as much as we do has been…well there aren’t really words. Some of our favorite reactions came from those of you watching the Game Awards live; you know who you are!

[h2]How can you help us?[/h2]
Please wishlist on Steam and consoles. This is the #1 way you can help the team here and to share your excitement about the announcement. We’d also love to see you on Discord or your platform of choice.
